heroSubtitle: WellDoneDrill, a Belgian player in geothermal drilling, is building the energy foundations of tomorrow today. A specialist in closed-loop and open-loop geothermal energy, our company offers sustainable, tailor-made solutions for all types of buildings.
heroTitle: Let's give clean and sustainable energy to future generations
missionBody1: We help reduce the carbon footprint of our regions by making geothermal energy accessible to everyone, for all types of projects, and on a large scale.
missionBody2: Faced with the climate emergency and the need to move away from fossil fuels, geothermal energy stands out as a solution for the future: clean, renewable and stable. Yet Belgium lags considerably behind in developing these technologies. It is in this context that WellDoneDrill was born, with a strong conviction: to make geothermal energy accessible and high-performing to meet a fast-growing demand.
missionBody3: Since our founding, we have completed hundreds of boreholes in Belgium, for homeowners, property developers, public institutions and companies.
missionTitle: Our mission goes beyond energy savings.
partnershipBody: Do you have a geothermal project? Let's talk about it. Our team replies within 48h.
seoDescription: WellDoneDrill, a Walloon geothermal drilling specialist. Discover our mission, our values and our expertise in closed-loop and open-loop geothermal energy.
seoTitle: About WellDoneDrill | Geothermal drilling in Belgium

values.body: We are committed to staying at the forefront of innovation in geothermal drilling. We invest in research and development to harness new technologies and improve our processes.
values.title: Innovation

values.body: We are convinced that geothermal energy is a powerful lever for a clean and sustainable energy future. Every borehole drilled is a direct contribution to reducing CO₂ emissions and decarbonising buildings.
values.title: Sustainability

values.body: We believe in the power of collaboration. It is by working hand in hand with our partners, clients and employees that we can reach our goals.
values.title: Collaboration

values.body: We act with rigour, ethics and transparency in all our work. Our commitments are clear, our methods controlled and our client relationships built on trust and accountability.
values.title: Integrity

values.body: We aim for the highest quality standards in every project. Our technical demands and attention to detail make WellDoneDrill a benchmark in its field.
values.title: Excellence

whyItems.body: We offer state-of-the-art geothermal drilling technologies while keeping operating costs under control.
whyItems.title: Accessible technologies

whyItems.body: Our detailed knowledge of the Walloon subsurface and our years of field experience ensure precise, safe drilling tailored to local conditions.
whyItems.title: Walloon geological expertise

whyItems.body: Our clients benefit from direct contact with a local team, involved at every stage of the project.
whyItems.title: Local & responsive

whyItems.body: Whether you are a homeowner, developer, company, architect or public institution, we develop tailor-made solutions.
whyItems.title: Flexible solutions
